issues.observation: A chamber ring crosses the horizontal center while a foreground column blocks the left side of the hero.
issues.desiredOutcome: Keep the environment depth but give the hero an uninterrupted readable silhouette in the wide view.

issues.observation: Large spherical shoulder and elbow forms dominate the medium view and read as simple primitives rather than engineered joints.
issues.desiredOutcome: Show layered load bearing joints with separate armor shells mechanical cores and connection gaps.

issues.observation: The medium camera is so tight that shoulders and elbows crowd the frame and obscure the action relationship.
issues.desiredOutcome: Retain intimacy while restoring negative space around the upper body and the contact action.

issues.observation: The close view improves on a sphere but the helmet remains one large shell with circular side pods and too little facial segmentation.
issues.desiredOutcome: Create a readable brow visor cheek jaw and side mechanism hierarchy without losing the established silhouette.

issues.observation: The hero has many counted parts but broad torso and helmet surfaces still lack convincing mid scale panel structure.
issues.desiredOutcome: Add sparse functional panel breaks overlaps vents and fastener groupings at a readable middle scale.

issues.observation: The close view leaves little breathing room around the helmet and amplifies the simple side pod silhouette.
issues.desiredOutcome: Keep the close emotional scale while allowing the complete head silhouette and facial layers to read.
